title: Creation: Bill Callahan talks about his latest release 'Gold Record' with Lauren and Simon on Breaking and Entering
summary: American singer-songwriter Bill Callahan contemplates family, cars, nostalgia and his new album Gold Record with Lauren Taylor and Simon Winkler on Breaking and Entering. He muses on the topic of how creating a family is similar to creating artistic works: "it's kind of paying tribute to creation when we create".
